comment: Data for on-phone routing (#3, #45). Built once for the whole covered area and split into 1-degree grid cells. bbox = lon min, lat min, lon max, lat max: only published packs that meet the area are kept (#60): poly is the outline of the extract, bbox the fallback when it cannot be downloaded. Source: OpenStreetMap Italy (openstreetmap.fr mirror, much faster than Geofabrik from GitHub runners).
